hours_note: Google Maps shows no hours field ("Add hours"). A third-party directory (care.com, self-reported by the business, last updated circa 2016) lists Mon-Fri 8:00-18:30, Sat/Sun closed, but this is unverified and stale, so it was omitted rather than risk publishing wrong hours.
website_check: No DNS record for aworkofartpetstudio.com or www.aworkofartpetstudio.com (connect_unreachable). Google Maps detail page confirms website field empty ("Add website"). No IG or FB profile found with a bio link either.

reviewSamples.author: Susan Power
reviewSamples.text: My chihuahua is 13yrs old and She was totally comfortable with Anna. Her coat was the softest ever nails trim perfectly. Very Happy and Im picky.

reviewSamples.author: Kathie & Dick Rhodes
reviewSamples.text: Staff was friendly and results were wonderful. Our Golden was way past due for grooming and they did a great job getting her looking like new! Already have an appointment for next grooming in 8 weeks to make their job easier next time.

reviewSamples.author: Tammy Payne
reviewSamples.text: Mrs. Debbie and her team are wonderful! Luna and Scottie just love them. Luna is a Bernedoodle. Everytime she is cut, they do an amazing job!

reviewSamples.author: Diane Maimone
reviewSamples.text: I bought my maltipoo in for grooming and they apparently shaved/burned her under her neck which left a huge scab. ... (negative, not usable as testimonial)

reviewSamples.author: Lznvs87@Gmail. Com Nieves
reviewSamples.text: Very rude as I called for info ... (negative, not usable as testimonial)

fotos.source: Google Maps listing has only 6 photo entries total; gmaps_photocycle.js (20 and 30 steps) and gmaps_detail2.js (network-sniffing) both converged on the SAME set after dedup: only 4 distinct images exist (2 of the 6 listing entries were exact-duplicate URLs of ones already captured).

downloaded.note: Dog on checkered lobby floor, visibly blurry (motion blur), dog looks happy (tongue out), but image quality too poor for a premium hero/gallery tile.

Dark, blurry shot of a dog from behind near a groomer's legs and a welcome mat. Too low quality and not a finished-groom shot.
Well-lit, sharp photo of a freshly groomed goldendoodle lying on a wood floor, happy expression. The only genuinely usable, premium-quality photo found.

email_search_note: Checked dogdog.org listing, care.com listing, Facebook page link found via care.com (facebook.com/pages/A-Work-of-Art-Pet-Studio/375744337639, returns HTTP 400 / appears defunct), and general web search. No public email found anywhere.
fb_note: A Facebook page link appears in an old care.com listing (facebook.com/pages/A-Work-of-Art-Pet-Studio/375744337639) but it returns HTTP 400 and could not be verified as a live, current page, so it was not used as a contact channel.

failure_reason: Fewer than 5 usable real photos. Only 4 distinct photos exist anywhere for this business (Google Maps is the only photo source found; no IG/FB gallery, no own site, no booking platform). Of those 4, one is a graphic wound/injury photo tied to a negative review that can never be published, leaving only 3 (1 good + 2 blurry/marginal) usable images, below the pipeline's 5-photo minimum for a premium build.
